question: Operator step with a free account for each provider. IPinfo Lite: download ipinfo_lite.mmdb with a token (curl -L https://ipinfo.io/data/ipinfo_lite.mmdb?token=TOKEN) and record the HTTP status, the byte size and the sha256. MaxMind GeoLite: sign in, record the size in bytes of each GeoLite database file (City, Country and ASN, in MMDB and CSV) on the Download Files page, then download one file through its permalink with the account ID and the license key and record the status, the byte size and the sha256. IP2Location LITE: download DB11LITEBIN with the token (wget https://www.ip2location.com/download?token=TOKEN&file=DB11LITEBIN) and record the status, the byte size and the sha256.
why: unverified: behind a sign-up. A download with no credentials answers HTTP 401 (IPinfo, MaxMind) or a redirect to the log-in page (IP2Location). The vendors list sizes: the IPinfo Lite MMDB is 24.84 MB in the listing of 2026-10-30, the MaxMind MMDB files since 2026-10-07 are ASN 8.5 MB, City 50 MB and Country 3 MB, and the IP2Location DB11 MMDB is 85.25 MB in the version of 01 November 2026. The measured byte sizes need an account.
